Expectations from the candidates:
 Candidates having an UG degree in Computer Applications with first class and a PG degree (i.e.
MCA/M.Sc.(IT)) with first class may also apply for the computer-related discipline.
 Proficiency in curriculum design, assessment strategies, and continuous evaluation techniques
aligned with Bloom’s Taxonomy and NEP standards.
 Strong mentorship skills for academic, career, and project guidance at undergraduate and
postgraduate levels, encouraging candidates to see their role as vital in shaping future professionals.
 Candidates holding industry-recognized certifications such as AWS Certified, Microsoft Azure,
Red Hat, CCNA, or other relevant credentials will be given additional weightage.
 Proven capacity to connect students with industry for internships, live projects, and placement
opportunities.
 Demonstrated ability to pursue high-quality research in emerging areas of Computer Science.
 Research ability should be substantiated by research publications in Scopus/Web of Science-
indexed journals.
 Research outcome should be in line with Product/ Patent/ outcome supported by Scopus / Web of
Science-based publications.
 Strong knowledge and practical expertise in Electrical Engineering, with proficiency in Embedded
Systems, Power Electronics, IoT, Industrial Automation, Robotics, and Industry 4.0, is desirable.

CHARUSAT also invites applications from eligible candidates for its Online (BCA) and
Online (MCA) Programs:
Teachers for Online BCA or Online MCA Programs shall have the same qualifications and
experience criteria as the Teachers of the Computer Applications program. Along with it, the
following key skills are required:
1. Proficiency in using various online teaching tools and platforms, such as Zoom, Google
Classroom, and LMS like Moodle.
2. Experience in developing customised course content (All four quadrants of SWAYAM),
lesson plans, and educational materials tailored to meet the diverse needs of students.
3. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, which can effectively engage with students,
parents, and colleagues.
4. Dedication to staying updated on the latest trends and best practices in online education,
ensuring the delivery of high-quality instruction.

Selection Process phases for the faculty position:
1. Candidates will be shortlisted based on defined eligibility criteria (qualifications and
experience).
2. The Scrutiny Committee reserves the right to decide the disciplines as concerned/ allied/
relevant while scrutinizing the applications.
3. The decision of the Scrutiny Committee shall be final and binding.
Shortlisted candidates will appear in the following selection process:
(A) Domain Knowledge Test and/or Ideation and Problem-Solving Test :
This stage is designed to allow candidates to exhibit their domain area/subject specialisation,
creativity and problem-solving skills. Solutions suggested by the candidates to the given
problem cases will be assessed for technical correctness, innovative approach, and critical
and problem-solving skills.
Type of Questions: Multiple Choice questions and /or Theoretical/Descriptive type
questions with a case study analysis in their domain areas will be given.
(B) Classroom Teaching through Chalk & Board:
 Candidates are required to deliver a 5–7-minute classroom teaching session using
the Chalk & Board method on a topic related to their subject specialisation.
 The Classroom Teaching should clearly demonstrate originality of content, clarity of
explanation, and structured delivery (introduction, main content, and conclusion).
 Candidates must focus on effective communication skills, including error-free English,
brevity, confidence, and appropriate body language.
 Candidates must rely only on chalk and board with diagrams or key points.
(C) Personal Interview: This stage is designed to allow candidates to exhibit their aptitude in
the domain area through their in-depth subject knowledge, their inclination for academic
assignments (i.e., teaching and research), and their attitude towards the teaching profession
and perception.
(D) HR Interview: Candidates are communicated the expectations of the university and the
terms of employment. Their expectations and aspirations are also understood.
Selection Process for the Executive/Officer @ CDPC
(A) Written test on Communication Skills: Writing skills in English and vernacular language
(B) Computer proficiency Test: MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power-point presentation, Email
drafting, Information finding, etc.
(C) Personal Interview: This stage is designed to allow candidates to exhibit their aptitude in
the domain area through their in-depth subject knowledge, their inclination for industry
collaboration, liasioining, lobbying for student placements, and their attitude towards the
academic profession and perception.
(D) HR Interview: Candidates are communicated the expectations of the university and the
terms of employment. Their expectations and aspirations are also understood.

Expectations of University:
As an outcome, CHARUSAT is preparing industry-ready human resources, wherein the
majority of the students should get employment as soon as they complete their education or
become job creators by becoming an entrepreneur. To achieve this objective, we are expecting
the faculty members to follow the following approach & methodology:
 Rigorous outcome-oriented teaching & learning methodology by using innovative learning
techniques like regular exposure to industry and their plants, good internship, well-designed
& monitored linked incentives and credit system.
 Faculty need to integrate their industrial and consultancy experiences while teaching and
use case studies and real-life examples.
 Faculty should be encouraged to involve their students in industrial consultancy projects.
 Key practical experiments and case studies to be taken up in real-life situations to explain
inter-linkage, complexities, and relevance of various concepts of professional areas.
 To develop entrepreneurship skills in students.
 Imparting & guarding value-based education in every aspect of teaching & campus life.
Skills required: He /she should be adaptable and have a flair for all the above approaches and
methodologies in order to meet the objective of the Institution and their self-development.
